verdict.rationale: React lets components declare and manage their own state, and it updates the screen when that data changes (react-gh-1, react-docs-3, react-docs-24). Re-execution is scoped to the component that owns the state; narrowing it further depends on memoization, which React Compiler automates at build time in place of manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo (react-docs-15). Nothing in the pack shows true fine-grained dependency tracking that re-runs only the specific dependent UI code. Missing for 10: evidence of fine-grained, dependency-tracked reactivity (signal-like) rather than component-level re-rendering, first-party docs on state/re-render semantics, independent corroboration that only dependent code re-runs.
